done_when: forge test --pytest runs the whole suite for a pyproject.toml change only when its dependency or pytest settings change, and only related tests otherwise; every uv command Forge runs uses the lockfile without rewriting it, so no Forge command leaves uv.lock changed; one command test per case; new and earlier-adopted client repos get it, with a command test for each

findings.body: The uv projection omits dependency settings including `build-constraint-dependencies`, `extra-build-dependencies`, `dependency-metadata` and `dependency-groups`. Changing only one of these leaves both snapshots equal, so Forge selects related tests—or returns without testing—instead of running the full suite. New evidence beyond the parsed-settings ruling: [uv documents these fields](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/reference/settings/) as build dependencies, dependency metadata and group Python requirements. Dependency-resolution settings such as `resolution`, `prerelease`, `exclude-newer` and legacy `index-url`/`extra-index-url` are also omitted. Include the dependency-affecting settings in the comparison and extend the command regression table; its sole uv case currently changes `constraint-dependencies`, so it cannot detect these omissions.

findings.body: The named proof `test_2_ci_runs_the_documented_pytest_command` never requires `--frozen`: it reads the expected command from `forge.toml` and checks that the workflow contains that same command. Removing `--frozen` from both files would still pass. It also never checks `fast_test`. The new lock-preservation tests launch Forge directly, so they cannot catch an outer `uv run` rewriting the lock before Forge sets `UV_FROZEN`. Add an independent frozen assertion for both configured commands, or exercise them with a mismatched recorded lock and `UV_FROZEN=0`. This is missing proof for the explicitly claimed outer-command rule.
findings.title: Not done: proof that Forge's own outer uv commands are frozen

why: Any pyproject.toml change makes forge test --pytest run the whole suite locally (30+ minutes holding the test slot), and uv run rewrites uv.lock back to an old cached version in older worktrees, leaving stray changes that block closes and cleanup
